title: Tables and columns
p: Use a table when you need to compare several things across the same dimensions. Use columns when you want independent ideas side by side. Both layouts can contain more than plain text.
Choose Table from the slash menu and select a size in the grid, up to 9 × 9. Press ⌘ ⌥ A to insert a 3 × 3 table directly. Tables pasted from Markdown, web pages or Feishu become editable tables too.
This example combines header cells, a merged row, backgrounds, alignment, tasks and lists.

ul.li: Select cells: drag from one cell to another to select a rectangular range.
Select a row or column: click its gray handle. Hold Shift to extend the selection.
Insert rows or columns: hover between their handles and click the plus control.
Reorder: select a row or column, then drag it.
Resize: drag a column boundary. The block menu can distribute column widths evenly.
Delete: select a row or column and use the toolbar's delete control.

td.p: Merge a rectangular selection into one cell, or split a previously merged cell.
Use cell colors to show groups or status.
Align left, center or right; place content at the top, middle or bottom.
Apply bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code or text colors to the selected cells.

p: Enable a header row in the table's block menu to style the first row and keep it visible while scrolling a long table. A header column styles the first column for comparison tables.
Cells can hold paragraphs, headings, lists, tasks, code and equations. Press Enter to add another paragraph within a cell.

pre.code: git switch -c feature/table git push -u origin HEAD

td.p: Code blocks make useful command references.
Mix equations with text and multiple paragraphs.

callout.p: Paste a Markdown table made with | separators to create a table. Markdown export writes tables in that format too.

p: Choose Columns from the slash menu, then choose one to five columns. Each column is an independent area that can contain other blocks.

ul.li: Documents you can back up yourself

column.p: Press ⌘ ⇧ N for a new note window and write down the idea.
Group related pages, pin the essentials and favorite useful references.
Search with ⌘ J and follow backlinks to connected notes.

p: Drag the gap between columns. Widths gently snap near equal splits and simple proportions.

column.p: A calm, reliable writing tool that keeps your notes in your hands

ul.li: Hover between columns and click the plus control to add one, up to ten columns.
Remove all content from a column to remove that column. When only one remains, the layout returns to ordinary blocks.
